name: Medusa
description: In Greek mythology, the only mortal of the three Gorgon sisters, whose gaze turned onlookers to stone and who was beheaded by the hero Perseus; her severed head, the Gorgoneion, became Athena's apotropaic symbol set on the Aegis.

aliases.name: Gorgo / Gorgon
aliases.meaning: 'Dreadful one'; used for all three Gorgon sisters

regions: Mythic 'far west' beyond Ocean (in archaic geography)
origin: Medusa is a figure of ancient Greek mythology, transmitted across the Greek and Roman Mediterranean and into the broader European tradition through Latin sources (notably Ovid).
